Use exactly the same art style, colour palette, rock shapes, sand ripples and palm trees as the reference images 2 and 3 (red-brown rocky outcrops with lighter pink highlights and dark red outlines, pale yellow sand with a diagonal wavy ripple pattern, green palm trees with dark green fronds and thin brown trunks, little tufts of green grass).

Draw ONLY THE LAND of a beautiful tropical beach cove seen from a three-quarter top-down angle, following the layout diagram of image 1 EXACTLY (same composition, same proportions, same positions). The most important point is the WIDE BAY: the magenta bay of image 1 is very wide, a big bowl that spans about three quarters of the image width near the top and narrows gently down to a long curved shoreline in the middle of the image; the two rocky headlands are therefore NARROW diagonal slopes of red rocks hugging the left and right edges, rising up to the top corners, never entering the middle of the picture. Below the bay: a wide pale yellow sandy beach in the lower half, a group of three palm trees at the foot of each headland, a few small red rocks on the sand, a driftwood log, two small shallow tide pools, a few pink and white seashells and one orange starfish, tufts of green beach grass at the foot of the rocks, and a lighter trodden sand path from the bottom centre going up to the middle of the beach. Warm sunlight from the upper left, soft shadows under the palms and rocks.

CRITICAL: everything that is sea or sky is just the empty background and must be a perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF area with hard sharp edges: the entire upper part of the image and the whole wide bay of image 1. The bay is like a hole in the picture: do NOT draw ANY sand, sand ripples, wet sand, water, foam, shadow or reflection inside it, and do NOT tint, fade or blend any sand or rock towards magenta anywhere. The sand keeps its normal pale yellow colour all the way up to a hard clean edge (only a thin band of darker golden wet sand) where it meets the flat magenta directly. No sky, no clouds, no sun, no horizon line. No characters, no text, no UI, no frame, no border, no vignette. Full 4:3 landscape image.
